description: This file defines the CachedMessagePool class, which manages a pool of cached message blocks to optimize memory usage and reduce garbage collection pressure in a streaming system. It provides methods to allocate message blocks and handle message storage within those blocks.

classes.name: CachedMessagePool
classes.description: Manages a pool of cached message blocks to efficiently store messages and reduce GC pressure.

methods.name: CachedMessagePool
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the message pool with a cache data adapter.

methods.name: AllocateMessage
methods.description: Allocates a message in the current message block, creating a new block if the current one is full, and returns the block containing the message.
